name: ncal
description: Displays a calendar and the date of Easter

options.name: -J
options.description: Display Julian Calendar, if combined with the -e option, display date of Easter according to the Julian Calendar

options.name: -e
options.description: Display date of Easter (for western churches)

options.name: -j
options.description: Display Julian days (days one-based, numbered from January 1)

options.name: -m
options.description: Display the specified month.  If month is specified as a decimal number, it may be followed by the letter ‘f’ or ‘p’ to indicate the following or preceding mont…

args.name: month
args.description: Display the specified month.  If month is specified as a decimal number, it may be followed by the letter ‘f’ or ‘p’ to indicate the following or preceding mont…

options.name: -y
options.description: Display a calendar for the specified year

options.name: -o
options.description: Display date of Orthodox Easter (Greek and Russian Orthodox Churches)

options.name: -p
options.description: Print the country codes and switching days from Julian to Gregorian Calendar as they are assumed by ncal.

options.name: -s
options.description: Assume the switch from Julian to Gregorian Calendar at the date associated with the country_code.

options.name: -w
options.description: Print the number of the week below each week column
Display the previous, current and next month surrounding today

options.name: -A
options.description: Display the number of months after the current month

options.name: -B
options.description: Display the number of months before the current month

options.name: -d
options.description: Use yyyy-mm as the current date (for debugging of date selection)

args.name: yyyy-mm
args.description: Date to use as the current date

options.name: -H
options.description: Use yyyy-mm-dd as the current date (for debugging of highlighting)

args.name: yyyy-mm-dd
args.description: Date to use as the current date
